name: LAF_NO_FREEZE
meaning: Rock: CamShot noFreeze = -(flags&1). Never set in practice: seesaw_LaunchObject computes it as (seesaw FLAGS & 2) & 1 = 0 (0x4ef2ad-0x4ef2c7), so a seesaw launch shot always freezes Ralph

name: LAF_2D_ZY
meaning: outputs are (z, y); x stays obj.x

name: LAF_3D
meaning: outputs are (x, y, z); set by seesaw_LaunchObject. Neither bit: (x, y) with z = obj.z

name: LAF_SKIP_SHEEP
meaning: copied from seesaw_LaunchObject's last argument; the seesaw_AddBody branch that would skip Sheep carrying it is dead code; the seesaw_AddBody branch that would skip Sheep carrying it is dead code (inferred)
